crossRefs.note: When they had brought their boats to land, they left everything, and followed him.
He said to them, “Come after me, and I will make you fishers for men.”
As Jesus passed by from there, he saw a man called Matthew sitting at the tax collection office. He said to him…
Then Peter answered, “Behold, we have left everything, and followed you. What then will we have?”
Peter began to tell him, “Behold, we have left all, and have followed you.”
However, I consider those things that were gain to me as a loss for Christ.

people.name: Peter
people.line: Apostle of Jesus, leader in the early church

translations.web: Peter said, “Look, we have left everything and followed you.”
translations.bsb: “Look,” said Peter, “we have left all we had to follow You.”
translations.kjv: Then Peter said, Lo, we have left all, and followed thee.
translations.asv: And Peter said, Lo, we have left our own, and followed thee.
